sentences.text: Shri Alok Vagricha, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Devendra Gangarade, learned PP for the respondent / State.
Urgent hearing application is heard through Video Conferencing during COVID- 19 for hearing on IA No.4280/2020 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Considering the reasons assigned therein, it is allowed.
Records of both the courts below are received.
However, hearing on admission will take time, therefore, today only IA No.4280/2020 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail is being heard through Video Conferencing.

Heard on I.A.No.4280/2020 filed by the applicant / accused under section 397 (1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of his jail sentence awarded by the Court of 12 th Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal in criminal appeal no. 771/18 vide its judgment dated 19.2.2020 convicting the applicant under sections 7 (i) r/w 16 (1) (a) (i) and 7 (V) r/w 16 (1) (a) of the Food Adulteration Prevention Act, 1954 and sentencing him to undergo RI for 1 year along with fine of Rs.5000/- and RI for 1 year along with fine of Rs.5000/- respectively with default stipulation as mentioned in the impugned judgment.

entities.text: Court of 12 th Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties through Video Conferencing and considering that the applicant is in jail since 19.2.2020 and further looking to the short period of sentence and other facts and circumstances of the case, it is ordered that subject to payment of fine amount, if not already deposited, the execution of jail sentence of the applicant Naresh Kumar Tanwani shall remain suspended until further orders and he be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.40,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial court on 20.8.2020 and thereafter, on all the dates as may be fixed by the trial court subject to final order on the application.
In view of the outbreak of Corona Virus Disease (COVID-19), the applicant shall also comply with the rules and norms of social distancing.

sentences.text:
Further, in view of the order passed by the Hon'ble Supreme court in suo motu W.P.No.1/2020,
it would be appropriate to issue the following directions to the Jail authority :-
1. The Jail Authority shall ensure the medical examination of the applicant by the jail doctor before his release.
2. The applicant shall not be released if he is suffering from Corona Virus Disease and for this purpose, appropriate tests will be carried out.

3. If it is found that the applicant is suffering from Corona Virus Disease,
necessary steps will be taken by the concerned authority by placing him in 2 CRR-1181-2020 appropriate quarantine facility.
4. If the applicant is not found infected with the alleged virus, the jail authority shall ensure his transportation from the jail to his place of residence.
The transportation shall be done in full compliance of the rules and norms of social distancing.
List this case for admission and consideration of aforesaid pending IA after four weeks.
